summary: Python library for audio and music signal analysis, including onset and spectral features. It can produce numeric data for offline audio-reactive workflows; it does not itself establish animation synchronisation.
use_when: Analyse audio features offline in Python for a motion experiment
Compare detected onsets with known audio events
avoid_when: Need browser playback or live audio processing: Web Audio
Need video encoding or muxing: FFmpeg
